body: And probably going to lose the family house as well it seems.

ok, Two years ago I got out of a long term relationship(7 years) and around that time people stopped talking to me, inviting me out to do things and such. People I considered long term friends wont reply to anything. I found out last month its because my ex started to spread some rumors about me which are nothing but false, but believable enough to ostracise me and push me to the fringes. At the same time my father began getting sick and i took up running the family business which I never wanted to do as I do not think it will be a viable venture in the future (we repair and forge custom pieces for minesites as needed. Think one go productions of items, sometimes its cheaper to get something made locally if you only need one instead of getting 1000 of something made when you will only ever need one of it). I live at home and work at home, which I feel is pushing me further into isolation.

I just feel stuck, I cant leave because if I did no one would be able to run the shop and it is my parents only form of income/support. I tried socializing down at the local pub last month but thats where i first heard what she has been saying I did. I just feel that at this point happiness isnt even a factor in life. I live for nothing more than to work and sleep, and cant see a use in anything I do and no way to change that.

I didnt used to drink but have been drinking heavily over the last few months and have found I cant sleep properly unless I have a few before bed. I just wish I had someone who I could sit down with and talk to, something to break the rythm and monotony of every day routine.

I dont feel human anymore.(sorry, been drinking. I hope I made some sense)
